Fanttik B10 Pro Max Electric Air Duster - use 11% off code LGRB10PM at Amazon: https://amzn.to/49J7yAS 

Dell made swappable lid covers for their Inspiron laptops in the early 2000s, and of course, one of them being a burled woodgrain means I had to have one. But then it turns out the 600M is pretty sweet in both its features and design! And with parts still being rather common and affordable, it was fun to quickly gather up a buncha goodies and fix this one up.
